item.title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
item.description:

In one region, his CDU party is barely above the threshold required to enter the state assembly, and it faces the prospect of falling to second in the capital , too. Eight state premiers, all from the CDU, backed Merz ahead of ballots being cast and Germany has little history of replacing chancellors mid-term.
